ayahOccurrences.text: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَٰفِظِينَ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَغُوصُونَ is in the derivative form: يَغوص
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
غ/و/ص   gh–w–ṣ to dive under water, to dive for pearls, diver, a dive. Of this root, يَغوصون yaghūṣūn and غَوّاص ghawwāṣ occur 1 time each in the Qur’a
n
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَغوص yaghūṣ [imperf. of v. غَاصَ ghāṣa, intrans.] to dive

(21:82) وَمِنَ‏ ‏الشَّيَاطِينِ‏ ‏مَنْ‏ ‏يَغُوصُونَ‏ ‏لَه and of the devils there are some who dive for him.

entries.label: يَغوص
entries.definitionHtml:
يَغوص yaghūṣ [imperf. of v. غَاصَ ghāṣa, intrans.] to dive

(21:82) وَمِنَ‏ ‏الشَّيَاطِينِ‏ ‏مَنْ‏ ‏يَغُوصُونَ‏ ‏لَه and of the devils there are some who dive for him.

entries.label: غَوّاص
entries.definitionHtml:
غَوّاص ghawwāṣ [intrans. act. part./n.] a diver, one who dives

(38:37) وَالشَّيَاطِينَ‏ ‏كُلَّ‏ ‏بَنَّاءٍ‏ ‏وَغَوَّاصٍ‏and of the devils, we have [subjected to him] every builder and diver.
